dedupe_keys.name: live road assessment custom dataset lira cd in vehicle sensor and road condition data copenhagen

description: The Live Road Assessment Custom Dataset (LiRA-CD) links in-vehicle sensor data from ordinary cars to the standard road condition parameters that road agencies use for planning and managing road networks. It holds 1,796 km of road data from highway and urban roads in the Copenhagen area collected in the LiRA project: more than 50 sensor signals and GPS trajectories from Renault Zoe electric cars operated by GreenMobility, recorded with a telematics unit on the vehicle CAN bus, and 92 road condition parameters from survey vehicles of the Danish Road Directorate, including road elevation, International Roughness Index, mean profile depth, rut depth and friction, plus a platoon friction test. It was produced at the Technical University of Denmark and described in a Data in Brief article (2023). Coverage is one city region (Copenhagen). The data are free under CC BY 4.0 and available to download from the DTU data repository as three subsets (car sensor data in HDF5 and text with a MATLAB reader, reference data as CSV, and the friction test). Caveats: it covers a limited road set and one vehicle type, and it was collected for research, not as a maintained monitoring service. It supports condition and ageing models of pavements, prediction of friction and roughness from connected vehicles and road energy consumption studies. It complements national pavement condition inventories and is related to the Montréal road assets database.
